name: Eagle County Regional Airport

runway.v: one runway, 9,000 ft (about 2,743 m) long and 150 ft (about 46 m) wide; field elevation 6,547 ft

handling.v: Signature Aviation is the FBO, on the south side of the airport

notes: Only the airport's own site flyvail.com could be read (Statistics & Research and Signature Aviation pages, no dates shown); it states no curfew, customs or operating hours. The CBP fact sheet for Eagle County (KEGE GA Airport Fact Sheet, 1 Sep 2026, https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-09/KEGE%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260901.pdf) exists but cbp.gov refused the fetch; eaglecounty.us/Airport and flyvail.com/general-aviation/ are robots-blocked. FAA Chart Supplement / d-TPP (aeronav.faa.gov), FAA NFDC airport data (nfdc.faa.gov, robots-blocked) and ADIP (adip.faa.gov) could not be opened. Metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
